prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: brand CHARACTER design proof for Looksy photo editor. ONE charismatic compact retro-future character, full body, shown in an attentive neutral stance. Character is robot-adjacent, a stylized living piece of friendly electronics with a recognizable face and simple limbs. NOT a human-shaped android, NOT an abstract eye, lens or logo. Design: head and body unified into one sturdy softly squared capsule, its dark integrated CRT face occupies upper half, two modest luminous expressive eye shapes that look interested and intelligent, NO mouth. Two short simple arms with rounded two-finger grippers, two very short sturdy legs with small broad rounded feet. Body about as wide as tall, limbs compact, total height only about 1.6 times bodywidth. Head/body feel like one integrated form, no neck, no separate torso, NO waist or hips. Subtle asymmetry in eye expression conveys warmth and curiosity. Poised neutral balanced stance, both feet on same ground, arms relaxed, no wink or hand-on-hip pose. Original memorable silhouette and sophisticated brand craft. No giant kawaii eyes, no baby proportions, no cartoon stickers. Smooth simple hardware shapes with minimal integral joint lines; no rivets, bolts, metal texture, tool belts, accessories, antenna, chest dials, optical aperture or camera lens. COLOR CRT RENDERING IS ESSENTIAL: character feels illustrated and rendered on a vintage color CRT display, fine RGB phosphor dots, fine horizontal scanlines, narrow red/cyan chromatic fringing at bright contours, subtly displaced tiny horizontal signal slices and sparse restrained glitches, localized soft bloom. Crisp flat illustrative broad shading, NOT glossy 3D plastic or realistic weathered metal. Palette: muted warm ivory capsule, deep blue-gray joints, pale cyan luminous eyes, faint amber and coral color-channel edges. NO green monochrome wash. Gentle screen texture without obscuring the clean silhouette. Near-black screen background, compact character centered with generous margins, no text, no logos, no UI, no props or scenery. This should be a strong useful little character with personality in its eyes and posture, never in human anatomy.
